subject: Compliance bundle — flex fee vs commit split
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@healtech.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance packaging questions — audit logs/HSM/residency

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. A few follow-ups from our side as we try to align internal procurement and engineering:

- We need to understand the packaging options for the compliance add-ons (audit log retention tiers, KMS/HSM seats, and regional residency). Do you offer a single SKU bundle or modular line-items?
- Pricing motion: our CFO prefers a single monthly invoice. Can you do an amortized implementation fee + monthly recurring on one invoice, or do you require separate invoices for infra seats (HSM) and recurring service?
- Evidence delivery: what gets delivered at kickoff vs. what is delivered post go-live? We need an itemized evidence matrix for legal.

Goal: decide on pilot configuration by 11/20 so procurement can issue a PO before year-end.

Thanks —
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform
HealTech
[Attachment: requirements-ops-20271110.pdf (pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@healtech.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Nov 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Compliance packaging questions — audit logs/HSM/residency

Samir —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and two pragmatic packaging options below. Attaching an evidence matrix and a short pricing options pdf.

Packaging options (short):
1) Modular (line-item) — best for small pilot + scale ad-hoc.
   - Audit log: monthly GB tiers (30d / 180d / 365d)
   - KMS/HSM: charged as "HSM seats" with one-time seat onboarding + monthly seat fee
   - Residency: region flag with a regional surcharge (applied per-token for hosted, flat surcharge for dedicated)
2) Bundled Compliance Kit — single SKU that includes 180d audit logs, 2 HSM seats (pilot), and regional residency for one region.
   - Bundled SKU has a clearer unit price and is eligible for a pilot discount and a multi-year commit discount.

Invoice options: we can support a single consolidated invoice that amortizes a one-time implementation/attestation fee across N months (typical N = 6 or 12). We also support separate one-time invoice for HSM provisioning if your accounting requires cost-of-goods separation.

Evidence: attached "hipaa-evidence-matrix.xlsx" shows what we deliver at kickoff (SOW, attestation checklist, deployment plan), at go-live (SOC-derivative artifacts, encrypted key attestations), and post-go-live (audit log export samples, retention reports).

Proposed next step: confirm whether you want Modular or Bundled for the pilot and whether you prefer a single amortized invoice (6 or 12 months). If you prefer bundled, I can loop Ben with a draft commercial to hit procurement timelines.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hipaa-evidence-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@healtech.io>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: pilot commercial for HealTech (flex fee + commit)

Samir — looping in a couple folks from pricing/AM. Below is a concise commercial we can put in a short SOW for procurement to approve quickly.

High-level commercial (pilot, 3 months):
- Option A (Bundled Compliance Kit, pilot price): $30,000 one-time implementation (amortize across 6 months) + $8,500/month recurring (includes 180d audit logs, 2 HSM seats, residency in us-west). 10% pilot credit applied to first month.
- Option B (Modular line-items):
   - Audit log 180d tier: $6,000/month
   - HSM seats: $2,500/seat/month + $15,000 seat provisioning one-time
   - Residency flag (us-west): $1,000/month
   - Estimated modular monthly for pilot (2 seats): $11,000/month + $15,000 one-time.

Discounting: 15% one-year commit on the bundled SKU, 10% on modular if you commit to >$200k ARR.

Invoice handling: we can produce a single invoice that lists the amortized implementation line and recurring line(s). If you need the HSM provisioning as a separate billable for capital accounting, we can do a separate invoice for the seat provisioning.

Docs and links: SOW draft (short) attached; DocuSign link included for quick signature if you want to accept Option A and we’ll convert to a pilot SOW and provision once signed.

Action items:
- Samir: pick A vs B for pilot and confirm invoicing preference (single amortized invoice vs split).
- Iris/Marcus: prepare SOW with selected option and mark which attachments HealTech legal requires.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: po-catalogue-sow.docx (word)]
[DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/rc/Envelope/ABC-9341]

From: Samir Patel <samir@healtech.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal - HealTech <legal@healtech.io>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Proposal: pilot commercial for HealTech (flex fee + commit)

Ben / Irene —

Thanks for the clear options. Two quick items from procurement/legal:

1) We prefer Option A (Bundled Compliance Kit) for the pilot.
2) Procurement requires a single monthly invoice that includes the amortized implementation fee (12-month amortization preferred). Can you confirm that the DocuSign SOW will generate a single invoice line for the amortized implementation plus the recurring line? We need that language in the SOW so our finance team can route payment quickly.

Legal (cc'd): please advise if you need any additional artifacts from Redwood beyond the evidence matrix.

Samir
--
